name: kt-semg-lda
title: Forearm sEMG typing (KT-sEMG): key-window LDA with a causal z-score (P14-04 live model)
task: key-press classification, one window per key onset, 32 keys (W3C KeyboardEvent.code)

input.window: log-RMS of 2 sub-windows of [t - 0.15 s, t + 0.05 s] per channel, running z-score over the run
input.file_note: runN.csv + runN_keys.txt + runN_ts.txt of KT-sEMG v1.1; key onsets come from the key log (oracle timing)

licence.weights_status: CC BY 4.0 (user decision D11, 2026-11-22); the model card must keep the attribution. Not released yet: the upload as a GitHub release asset (D10) waits for a final user yes (P14-02, gap 98). Never in the wheel or the git repository
licence.attribution: KT-sEMG dataset, copyright 2021 Nokia, CC BY 4.0 (KT-sEMG v1.1, doi:10.7910/DVN/AV6XIR)

training.split: model: runs 1-11, 13 (benchmark track kt-semg v0.2 train); guard: runs 14, 15, 16, 19, 22, 23; test runs not used

limits: Weak baseline: about one key in four is right. The guard never commits on this decoder (correct behaviour).
One typist, session-to-session transfer only; no transfer to other people or devices.
Needs key onset times (oracle timing from the key log, or a live onset detector).

offer_control.rule: P5-31, docs/trust-guarantee.md section 5a: a control passes if null offer rate <= 0.5 x real offer rate, and (null offers <= floor(0.05 n) or one-sided Fisher exact p <= 0.05); real = the LTT items

controls.name: shuffled
controls.label: user nulls: key windows drawn at random

offer_control.effect: warn mode: no change to the guard, its config_id or its status. The offer list is not evidence that the signal was read

trust.input: the key n-best list of a stream: guard.decide(model.nbest(stream))

hosting.notes: no download URL yet; hosting is the user step P14-02 (docs/publishing-checklist.md)
